messages:
maya: Quick check — finalizing launch social plan for the feature demo webinar next Wed. Need assets + scheduling windows for X and LinkedIn. Who has the final hero clip?

sahil: I have a 30s cut, uploading to drive now. link: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/hero-30s :thumbsup:

maya: perfect — can you export 9:16 too? want to use for story snippets.

ana: tagging in case we need alt copy. @ana do you have headline variants?

ana: yep — 3 variants: 
- "Launch faster, serve smarter"
- "Ship LLM features with predictable latency"
- "Cut inference cost, keep quality"
I'll paste into the content doc.

maya: love option 2 for LinkedIn, option 1 for X. Ryan — can you confirm CTA URL routing for inbound? we want webinar signups -> engage SDR flow A, demo interest -> direct to calendar.

ryan: confirmed. I'll add UTM params. Webinar signups -> /signup?utm_campaign=microlaunch_social, routed to SDR queue "webinar-inbound". Demo interest button -> /book with param demo_flow=1.

maya: sweet. Ops-bot, can you add the calendar event for rehearsal Thurs 11am PT and set reminder to post draft for review by Tue 5pm PT?

ops-bot: Event created: "Microlaunch rehearsal" Thu 11:00 PT. Reminder set for Tue 17:00 PT to post drafts in #marketing-assets.

ana: quick note on benchmarks — let's call out latency/cost savings in the copy (short line), and link to the benchmark blog in the thread so we have a narrative. e.g., "99ms median latency, 3x cost reduction vs baseline."

maya: good call. include that as a stat card. Sahil can you add a 1-slide stat overlay for the clip?

sahil: will do. ETA EOD today.

maya: engagement follow-ups — after the first post, SDRs should respond to any comment with "Thanks — here's a short demo clip and a link to book a call". @ryan please share the canned reply.

ryan: canned reply added to shared doc: "Thanks for your interest! Here's a quick demo: <short clip link>. Want a live walkthrough? Book a 15-min slot: <book link>."

ana: also prepping 2 threaded posts for LinkedIn (teaser + deeper dive). will post teaser day before, deep dive on launch day.

maya: timeline recap: 
- Tue 17:00 PT: post drafts in #marketing-assets for review
- Wed (day before): teaser on LinkedIn + X
- Thu (launch): main posts across both channels + story clips
- After launch: SDR follow-up for all inbound comments/DMs

maya: any blockers?

sahil: none from me. uploading 9:16 now.

ana: copy done, will add to doc.

ryan: routing configured.

maya: great — thanks team. I'll do a final pass on tone tomorrow morning. :rocket:
